title: 23 November
subtitle: A special day in BAPS history
headline: Satsang Diksha Felicitation Ceremony, Nagpur, India
story:
Worldwide, under the auspices of the Mission Rajipo project initiated by Mahant Swami Maharaj, 15,666 children aged 3 to 14 memorized the entire Satsang Diksha scripture. Of these, 55 boys and girls are from the Nagpur region. A special felicitation ceremony was organized to honor the achievements of these young Vidwans (scholars).

On this occasion, the glory of the Satsang Diksha scripture and the benefits of its memorization were presented through dialogues, dances, quizzes, speeches, and other presentations. Dr. Pankaj Chande, founder and former Vice-Chancellor of Kavi Kulguru Kalidas University in Nagpur, graced the occasion and in his address explained the importance of the Sanskrit language and the Satsang Diksha scripture.

All the boys and girls who had memorized the Satsang Diksha scripture were seated in artistically decorated palkhis and felicitated with a shower of flowers. They were also honored with trophies, certificates, gifts, and garlands.

and the benefits of its memorization were presented through
dialogues, dances, quizzes, speeches, and other presentations.
Dr. Pankaj Chande, founder and former Vice-Chancellor of
Kavi Kulguru Kalidas University in Nagpur, graced the
occasion and in his address explained the importance of the
Sanskrit language and the Satsang Diksha scripture.

All the boys and girls who had memorized the Satsang
Diksha scripture were seated in artistically decorated
palkhis and felicitated with a shower of flowers. They were
also honored with trophies, certificates, gifts, and garlands.
lines: Worldwide, under the auspices of the Mission Rajipo
project initiated by Mahant Swami Maharaj, 15,666
children aged 3 to 14 memorized the entire Satsang Diksha
scripture. Of these, 55 boys and girls are from the Nagpur
region. A special felicitation ceremony was organized to
honor the achievements of these young Vidwans (scholars).
